title: Gursha (One Plate, One Heart)
style_block: Warm cinematic film still, golden afternoon sunlight in an Ethiopian home, subtle 35mm film grain, rich earthy reds, saffron, terracotta, and warm cream tones, shallow depth of field, centered composition safe for 16:9 and 9:16 crop.
character_description: A warm, welcoming Ethiopian family and close friends in their 20s to 60s wearing casual modern clothes mixed with subtle traditional white cotton netela scarves, gathered closely around a colorful woven mesob basket table, genuine warm smiles.
tts_style: Warm, heartfelt, proud, unhurried Ethiopian storytelling voice
music_cue: Warm, uplifting Ethiopian instrumental score with gentle krar, soft masinko, and light kebero pulse, nostalgic and communal mood, slow 76 BPM, minimal texture so narration sits clearly on top, instrumental only, no vocals.

shots.reason: Establish the lively Ethiopian neighborhood courtyard at golden hour and the culture of open doors and neighborly kinship
shots.narration_text: በኢትዮጵያ ሕይወት ብቻህን የምትኖረው አይደለም። ጎረቤት ቤተሰብ ነው፤ ቤትም ሁሌ ክፍት ነው።
shots.subtitle_en:
In Ethiopia, life is never lived alone.
Neighbors are family, and doors stay open.
shots.image_prompt: Establishing shot of a lively Ethiopian neighborhood courtyard at golden hour, warm afternoon sun casting long glow across an open wooden doorway, neighbors greeting each other with warm smiles in the center frame, bougainvillea and earthen walls

shots.reason: Show family and friends gathering closely around a single woven mesob rather than separate plates
shots.narration_text: ስንገናኝ የምንቀመጠው በተለያየ ሳህን አይደለም። ሁላችንም በአንድ ገበታ ዙሪያ እንሰበሰባለን።
shots.subtitle_en:
When we meet, we don't eat from separate plates.
We gather around one shared table.
shots.image_prompt: Wide centered shot of an Ethiopian family and friends seated closely in a circle around a colorful woven mesob basket table in a sunlit living room, lid being lifted together, warm welcoming expressions
shots.motion_prompt: gentle push-in toward the shared mesob table

shots.reason: Visual insert of the shared platter of injera and colorful wot as a symbol of unity and trust
shots.narration_text: አንድ እንጀራ፣ ብዙ ዓይነት ወጥ—ግን አንድ ልብ። ከአንድ ማዕድ መብላት መተማመን ነው።
shots.subtitle_en:
One injera, many flavors—yet one heart.
Sharing one plate is an act of trust.
shots.image_prompt: Overhead close-up of a large round tray lined with fresh spongy injera topped with vibrant colorful mounds of Ethiopian wot: rich red doro wot, yellow kik alicha, crimson misir, golden shiro, and deep green gomen in the center

shots.reason: Capture the warmth of conversation, laughter, and hands reaching into the communal tray together
shots.narration_text: በማዕዱ ላይ ሳቅ አለ፣ ጨዋታ አለ፣ የቀኑ ድካም ሁሉ በወሬ ይረሳል።
shots.subtitle_en:
Around the table, laughter flows.
The weight of the day fades in conversation.
shots.image_prompt: Medium centered shot of Ethiopian family and friends laughing and talking warmly around the shared injera platter, multiple hands reaching gently toward the center of the tray, golden afternoon light through the window
shots.motion_prompt: gentle camera drift left across smiling faces

shots.reason: Pivot to the intimate physical preparation of a Gursha — tearing injera and scooping wot by hand
shots.narration_text: ከዚያም ከሁሉም የሚበልጠው የፍቅር ምልክት ይመጣል—ጉርሻ።
shots.subtitle_en:
Then comes our deepest gesture of love—
Gursha.
shots.image_prompt: Intimate close-up of a warm brown hand carefully tearing a soft piece of injera and wrapping it around a savory scoop of rich red wot in the center of the platter, soft golden rim light

shots.reason: Emotional centerpiece: an elder mother lovingly feeding a Gursha to a younger family member
shots.narration_text: የምትወደውን ሰው በእጅህ ስታጎርሰው፣ ቃላት አያስፈልጉም። «ከእኔ በላይ ቅድሚያ ያንተ ነው» ማለት ነው።
shots.subtitle_en:
Feeding someone you love needs no words.
It says, "You come before me."
shots.image_prompt: Medium close-up of a kind Ethiopian mother in a white cotton netela shawl lovingly extending her hand to offer a Gursha bite of injera to her smiling adult daughter across the mesob, tender eye contact, warm golden light
shots.motion_prompt: slow push-in on mother offering Gursha

shots.reason: Show the playful, joyful side of Gursha between friends where a bigger bite means deeper affection
shots.narration_text: ጉርሻ ለእናት፣ ለጓደኛ፣ ለእንግዳ ይሰጣል። ጉርሻው በተለቀ ቁጥር፣ ፍቅሩም ይበልጣል።
shots.subtitle_en:
We give Gursha to family, friends, and guests.
The bigger the bite, the deeper the love.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of two young Ethiopian friends at the shared table laughing joyfully as one playfully offers a generous Gursha bite of injera to the other, warm candid expressions centered in frame

shots.reason: Broaden to the whole glowing room to contrast communal Ethiopian tradition against modern isolation
shots.narration_text: ዛሬ ዓለም ሰዎችን ቢያርቅም፣ የእኛ ባህል ግን ሁሌም ወደ አንድ ማዕድ ይመልሰናል።
shots.subtitle_en:
Even in a world that pulls people apart,
our culture always brings us back together.
shots.image_prompt: Wide warm glowing interior shot of three generations of the Ethiopian family and friends gathered around the mesob table at golden dusk, warm amber light filling the room, everyone smiling and connected

shots.reason: Closing visual metaphor of hands resting together by the mesob to leave a lasting feeling of belonging
shots.narration_text: ምክንያቱም በኢትዮጵያ፣ ፍቅር የሚለካው በቃላት አይደለም—በአንድ ጉርሻ ነው።
shots.subtitle_en:
Because in Ethiopia, love isn't measured
in words—it's measured in a Gursha.
